Jaishankar Highlights India-Africa Partnership and Human Resource Development

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that India and Africa are a powerful force for global progress. He emphasized that human resource development is central to India's engagement with Africa. Jaishankar highlighted that India has offered 80,000 scholarships to African nations over the past 11 years. This engagement aims to foster mutual growth and progress between the two regions.
